actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent RNA metabolic-suppression signature with multiple FDR-significant pathways, stable internal structure (ARI 0.79, PAC 0.29) with positive modality separation, and no set-level technical confounding. Retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate.

C0002 has coherent RNA metabolic-up regulation and a significant DST mutation enrichment, with no technical confounding. Internal resampling stability is weak (ARI 0.50, PAC 0.78), so structural confidence is limited, but no positive evidence supports split or merge; retained for downstream validation with this caveat.

C0003 shows concordant RNA immune/inflammatory activation and strong FDR-significant BAP1 enrichment, moderate internal stability with positive modality separation, and no significant technical confounding. Retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate.

C0004 is defined by near-universal VHL mutation with low PBRM1/BAP1, a coherent mutation pattern, and no technical confounding. Structure is moderately stable but largely WXS-driven with low cross-modal membership support; no positive evidence supports split or merge, so it is retained with this caveat.

Although C0005 has coherent PBRM1/VHL mutation and RNA signaling evidence, it shows significant set-level technical associations with tissue source site (BP, OR 10.1, q=0.0034) and CT scanner model (LightSpeed16, OR 7.9, q=0.0034), providing a plausible competing technical explanation for its composition. This makes the candidate insufficiently defensible for retention.

C0006 is defined by striking FDR-significant VHL and PBRM1 depletion with a directionally consistent RNA down-regulation pattern and no technical confounding. Structure is highly stable but almost entirely WXS-driven with negligible cross-modal corroboration; no positive evidence supports split or merge, so it is retained with this caveat.
